Container.Name: Stackyard
Container.Overview: A self-hosted homelab dashboard you actually want to look at.[br][br]Most dashboards are a wall of numbers and charts. Stackyard is the opposite: a calm, launcher-style grid of app tiles, folders, and a small number of genuinely useful widgets. Built to be glanced at a hundred times a day without feeling cluttered.[br][br]Everything is set up from the browser. Add app tiles, group them into folders, arrange pages, and drop in widgets for the services you already run. Widgets cover Docker, system health, downloads, media, backups, network and more.[br][br]Runs as one container with no external database and no runtime dependencies. Configuration and uploaded icons persist in the two paths below.[br][br]Note: most homelab services live on private addresses. The Allow Private IPs setting below is on by default so links and widgets pointing at your other containers work. Turn it off to keep the SSRF guard enabled.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: homelab dashboard homepage self-hosted launcher start page widgets
Container.DonateText: If Stackyard is useful to you, you can buy me a coffee.
Container.Changes:
### 1.20.0 - 2026-10-27
### Added
- Draw 15 more weather conditions in the Weather widget, from mist to tornadoes.
- Group the Dashboard list into Dock and Home screen, with drag and drop into and out of the dock.
- Let the Settings tile go in the dock from its new editor.
- Sign in to a live badge's API with a username and password.
- Add a Proxmox health check that shows whether a VM or container is running.
- Add Proxmox VE as a System Summary source.
- Add Unraid as a Disk Health source.
- TrueNAS as a System Summary source.
- Allow Self-Signed Certificate for TrueNAS disk health.
- Add Proxmox Backup Server and Backrest as Backup widget sources.
- Show when a settings list from a service was cut short.
- Weather shows an icon when UV or air quality calls for care, with the reading on hover or tap.
- Read pull requests and contributions from Gitea and Forgejo, and merge requests from GitLab, in the Git widget.
- Downloads widget for qBittorrent, Transmission, Deluge, SABnzbd and NZBGet.
- Up Next widget for Sonarr, Radarr and Lidarr.
- Import apps and folders from gethomepage labels on Docker containers.
- Let widget text fields opt out of capitalisation and autocorrect with `"plain": true`.
- Add a Captain style to the Clock widget, a comic panel with the weekday, time, date and a glass of beer.
### Changed
- Long weather condition labels shrink to fit before they are cut off.
- Read numbers sent as text in live badges.
- Replace the Docker health checks switch with one Health Checks switch that covers every check type.
- TrueNAS disk health reads TrueNAS 25.04 and later over the WebSocket API, so it keeps working on TrueNAS 27.
- TrueNAS disk health refuses an http address. Change the address to https.
- Show the Backup widget's Source setting as a drop-down.
- Shrink the image by about 24 MB and run one nginx worker instead of one per CPU core.
- Rename the GitHub widget to Git.
- Limit app, folder and widget names to 64 characters.
- Warn in the app form when a link holds a username and password.
- Show press feedback on Settings rows, buttons and the tab bar.
- Glide dragged rows into place.
- Open menus and dialogs with a short animation.
- Make phone pages follow the finger, turn on a quick flick and stretch at the ends.
- Turn pages faster from the keyboard, wheel and page dots.
- Grow folders out of their tile and shrink them back on close.
- Keep fades under Reduce Motion and drop only movement.
- Reduce CPU use of the analog clock, Connections, Now Playing, Weather and Backup animations.
### Fixed
- Colour swatches no longer spread across the row on small tablets.
- Chinese Weather widget labels drizzle as 毛毛雨 instead of light rain.
- Large numbers in GitHub widgets fit again after the dashboard is resized.
- Widgets no longer show a strip of card at their sides when the card is wider than the widget's design.
- Widget loading placeholders show in high contrast mode.
- Read the Docker API through socket proxies that allow only versioned paths.
- Wrap long names in the import preview instead of scrolling sideways.
- Stop Settings rows and buttons from staying highlighted after a tap.
- Stop iOS from zooming into header fields.
- Stop iOS from capitalising addresses, usernames and System Summary disk names.
- Keep Save on screen when an app has a long name.
- Show addresses from their start in right-to-left languages.
- Stop a dragged row from sticking on screen when the list redraws during the drag.
- Show the start of long right-to-left app names, with the ellipsis at the end.
- Make empty-dashboard text readable on dark wallpapers in light mode.
- Keep typing and clicks working right after closing search.
- Show press feedback on phone app, Dock and folder tiles.
- Wrap long names in phone search.
- Turn the page on a swipe that starts on the phone search pill instead of opening search.
- Stop the dashboard from bouncing on iOS.
- Count both taps when switching Now Playing sessions quickly.
- Put the ellipsis at the end of right-to-left Dashboard Switch names.
- Stop widgets from flashing grey on tap on iOS.
- Show the phone home screen with a correctly sized Dock on phones held sideways.
- Stop iOS Safari from enlarging widget text in landscape.
- Keep the Settings sidebar on short landscape screens and on large screens such as an unfolded phone.
- Stop the home screen from enlarging icons on screens wider than a phone.
- Clock faces no longer show the wrong hour when the clock's timezone falls in the browser's daylight saving change.
- The Digital clock updates as soon as a hidden tab is shown again.
- Widgets declare the dashboard language, so screen readers read their text in that language.
- The Connections map names countries in the dashboard language.
- Credit the photographer and Unsplash on an Unsplash wallpaper, as Unsplash's API terms require.
- Keep the dashboard and Settings clear of the notch and status bar when Safari's page zoom is not 100%.
- The empty dashboard's heading and explanation stay readable on mid-grey wallpapers.
### Security
- Update Node.js to 24.22.1 and nginx to 1.30.6 to fix four CVEs.
- Stop trusting the compromised eMudhra certificate roots.
- Mark CVE-2026-107891 as not affecting the Docker Hub image, which ships the patched musl 1.2.6-r3.
- Refuse health check pings to link-local addresses, including the cloud metadata service.
- Remove usernames and passwords from links during import.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Port the dashboard is reached on.

Config.Name: Config Storage
Config.Description: Dashboard configuration. Keep this, or every setting is lost on update.

Config.Name: Icon Storage
Config.Description: Icons you upload for your app tiles.

Config.Name: Allow Private IPs
Config.Description: Let widgets and badges reach private addresses, which most homelab services use. Set to false to keep the SSRF guard on.

Config.Name: Docker Socket Proxy URL
Config.Description: Optional. Address of a Docker socket proxy, for the Docker widgets. Example: http://socket-proxy:2375

Config.Name: Trust Proxy
Config.Description: Optional. Set to true when running behind a reverse proxy, so client addresses are read from the forwarded headers.

Config.Name: Node Options
Config.Description: Node heap cap. Keep it near half the --memory limit in Extra Parameters, and raise both together.
